svg.title: Search Contacts -- User to MySQL and back

g.text: Search Contacts -- User to MySQL and back
SELECT ID, FirstName, LastName, Phone, Email
OR Phone LIKE ? OR Email LIKE ?)
Two things hold this endpoint together. The WHERE clause always starts with
UserID = ?, so the search term can only narrow that user's own rows and never
reach past them. And it is a prepared statement, so the SQL and the values
travel to MySQL separately: a term like ' OR '1'='1 is compared as literal text.
